text:
jen_partnerships: quick sync  SecuraVault (SI) wants a Marketplace co-listing (Redwood Private + SecuraVault secrets). asks: SAML sample, SCIM provisioning example, and KMIP/BYOK key-wrap demo. partner needs a short runbook + smoke script by Fri. @rachel_eng @lee_security can we take this? :clock1:

rachel_eng: I can own the smoke. plan: KMIP emulator in staging + SAML metadata exchange. do we have a SCIM incremental sync example?

lee_security: we do. add CA/thumbprint validation for KMIP TLS and require idempotency tokens for provisioning. no real certs in docs. also include a rollback (revert wrap key + mark secrets read-only).

olivia_sales: SecuraVault will provide a dev tenant and a non-prod KMIP endpoint with test certs. they'll want an integration checklist for roles and service accounts.

rachel_eng: rough steps I'll validate: 1) exchange SAML metadata (signed assertion example), 2) SCIM token + incremental group sync sample, 3) KMIP wrap/unwrap handshake, 4) call Redwood rotate API to confirm rotation. Posting minimal commands now.

rachel_eng: SCIM token example:
```bash
curl -s -X POST https://dev.securavault.example/scim/token -d '{"client_id":"sv-dev","client_secret":"REDACTED"}'
```

rachel_eng: rotate sample (sanitized):
```bash
curl -X POST https://private-api.staging.redwood-inference.local/v1/secrets/rotate -H 'Authorization: Bearer <TOKEN>' -d '{"secret_id":"sv-demo","kms_key_id":"kmip://sv-key-01"}'
```

ci-bot: CI job #securavault-integ smoke finished  6 tests, 1 flaky (SCIM pagination). logs: https://ci.redwood.dev/alg/5555 :white_check_mark:

rachel_eng: flaky due to large SCIM pages; switching to incremental sync + exponential backoff and an idempotency header. will push script Tue EOD.

lee_security: also add a short threat-model paragraph about cross-tenant KMS principal scope and limit token TTLs.

marc_pm: I can draft the 1-pager + 3 slides if eng gives commands/screenshots by Wed.

jen_partnerships: action items: Rachel (smoke + script) Tue EOD; Marc (runbook + slides) Wed EOD; Olivia (partner dev tenant & test certs) Wed AM; Lee (security blurb + rollback) Wed EOD. Marketing needs final assets Thu for rehearsal. Thanks team :rocket:
